blocks.text: SAN FRANCISCO — Kiah Stokes swatted shots and crashed the boards on both ends, pulling down seven rebounds while also blocking four shots. Kaila Charles came off the bench and contributed 10 rebounds, made two steals and also blocked a shot. Laeticia Amihere offered important intel on her former Atlanta team and took on the load against Angel Reese.
